level_rationale: A painful swollen pocket of white pus beside the right index fingernail developing 3 days after tearing a hangnail in a restaurant dishwasher indicates a localized acute periungual abscess requiring outpatient clinic evaluation and incision or antimicrobial care rather than home self-care alone or emergency department treatment, whereas clean smooth healed skin at that same hangnail site 3 days later reflects complete uncomplicated skin healing requiring only routine self-care.
